translations.web: “As for these things which you see, the days will come, in which there will not be left here one stone on another that will not be thrown down.”
translations.bsb: “As for what you see here, the time will come when not one stone will be left on another; every one will be thrown down.”
translations.kjv: As for these things which ye behold, the days will come, in the which there shall not be left one stone upon another, that shall not be thrown down.
translations.asv: As for these things which ye behold, the days will come, in which there shall not be left here one stone upon another, that shall not be thrown down.
